debate.name: Shree Krishna Paper Mills & Industries Ltd

rounds.text: Shree Krishna Paper Mills & Industries Ltd is currently undergoing a significant operational turnaround, evidenced by a 45% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E19] and a 54% year-over-year net profit increase [E52]. This performance is supported by a robust 27% compounded sales growth over the last five years [E15], far outpacing the 10-year average of 6% [E14]. The company is trading at a highly attractive valuation relative to its sector, with an EV/EBITDA of 3.61x compared to the sector benchmark of 7.73x [E11] and a P/E ratio of 5.15x against a sector benchmark of 14.82x [E6]. Furthermore, the company has demonstrated disciplined capital management by reducing borrowings from Rs 42 Cr to Rs 38 Cr in the last year [E36] while maintaining a healthy free cash flow of Rs 12 Cr [E34]. A discounted cash flow analysis suggests an intrinsic value of Rs 204 per share, providing a substantial margin of safety of 52.7% at the current market price [E40, E41]. Conceded: the company faces challenges including a 0.00% dividend yield [E4], a negative return on equity [E13, E27], and a high promoter pledge of 84.4% [E48]. Despite these headwinds, the recent acceleration in profit growth relative to price suggests the market has yet to fully price in this improving fundamental trajectory [E44, E57].
